purpose.zh: 静态练大腿和臀部耐力
purpose.en: Build thigh and glute endurance with a static hold.

text.zh: 背贴墙，大腿与地面平行，膝在脚踝上方
text.en: Back on the wall, thighs level, knees over your ankles

text.zh: 双脚与髋同宽，手臂向前伸直
text.en: Feet hip-width apart, arms reaching forward.

text.zh: 保持均匀呼吸，不要憋气
text.en: Breathe steadily and do not hold your breath.

commonErrors.en: Letting the knees drift far past the toes.
Letting the back come off the wall.

cautions.zh: 膝盖疼痛时蹲得高一些，仍痛就停止
cautions.en: Sit higher if your knees hurt, and stop if the pain continues.
